title: Web Development & DI Services | Keith Soyka
description: Hire Keith Soyka for web builds, audits, custom software, and Digital Intelligence (DI) integration. Explore bounded services and a free fit consultation.
h1: Look at the work. See how it's put together.
summary: Start with what your business needs — not a bigger build than you can use. Choose a defined service, understand its boundaries, and leave with a deliverable you can work with.
bodyHtml:
Start with what your business needs — not a bigger build than you can use. Choose a defined service, understand its boundaries, and leave with a deliverable you can work with.

Who you're hiring: Keith Soyka — operator-led, New York / remote. 22+ years running frontline operations — P&L, labor, inventory, multi-site transitions — and 17 months building GestaltView solo and unfunded.

Primary action: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

Validation marker: Pepperdine University Most Fundable Companies — Quarterfinalist 2025 · Top 100 of 2,300 startups · Solo, unfunded.

Find the right starting point

Standard 4-page site

$2,900

A from-scratch site that explains what you offer and gives people a way to contact you.

Included: landing, contact, about, and terms/privacy; implementation and design specifications; documented page purposes and connections; build documentation and tested handoff.

Not included: DI integration. Logo / branding and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped add-ons. Hosting options are compared separately.

See the website-build scope

DI opportunity audit

$650

Find out where Digital Intelligence (DI) could benefit your current business — and where it does not fit.

Included: a standalone assessment of opportunities in your current business: workflow and constraint map, build-versus-buy guidance, and a 90-day action plan ranked by where AI earns its keep.

Not included: implementing a website, software tool, or DI integration. This is an audit, not a build commitment.

See the opportunity-audit scope

AI Ops Sprint, two weeks

$2,500

A two-week engagement focused on an agreed operations scope: one workflow, rebuilt and working.

Included: a mapped workflow and leverage point, one working automation or AI-assisted process, a trained maintainer, complete documentation, and 30 days of fixes on the agreed build.

Not included: an open-ended operations engagement or unspecified follow-on work. A larger problem becomes a second, separately scoped sprint — not scope creep.

See the sprint scope

Codebase / website audit + refresh

scoped

Start with the code or website you already have rather than assume you need to start over.

Included: an audit and refresh within a separately agreed scope; price agreed for the existing system before work begins.

Not included: an automatic full rebuild or unlimited changes. The agreed scope determines which refresh work is included.

See the audit-and-refresh scope

Custom software (small tool, fixed scope)

$8,500–$10,000

A small software tool built around a defined job, with the plan and handoff documented. The final fee within the range is agreed before work begins.

Included: a fixed-scope build, implementation and design specifications, applicable flow documentation, tested delivery, and the build care package.

Not included: an open-ended product build. Ongoing maintenance, extra work, and logo / branding are separately scoped.

See the custom-software scope

DI integration (SMB, fixed scope)

$9,500

Digital Intelligence (DI) integrated into an agreed small-business workflow, with its operation and maintenance documented.

Included: fixed-scope integration, applicable API and DI flow documentation, a maintenance collaborator alongside the system's DI component, and the build care package.

Not included: unlimited integrations or ongoing maintenance. API subscription costs pass through; custom database costs are additional where applicable.

See the integration scope

Care is part of the build — not an upgrade

A build should not become a mystery when it changes hands. The base build price includes documented build, test, and deployment scripts; a Dockerized build for portability; and a documentation suite: README, quickstart, CurrentState, manifest, index, and handoff guide.

You also receive troubleshooting guidance, file-level provenance, and page contracts wherever pages are part of the build. Those contracts explain each page's purpose, connections, and expected behavior. Workflows and skills are tailored to the agreed stack. API and Digital Intelligence (DI) flows are documented where applicable. Tests must run green before handoff.

You can take the repository to another maintainer. Ongoing maintenance by me is an option, separately scoped — not a condition of keeping the work usable. Audit-only engagements do not promise a software build or its delivery kit.

The fit comes first

I do not sell Digital Intelligence (DI) where it does not help, or push a service that is not a sensible purchase for the business. Nothing offered here should be something you can get anywhere else — every offer must read, on its own merits, as an incredibly wise use of funds, not on pressure to buy.

I work solo, with low overhead and no agency markup. Scope stays explicit so you can judge what you are paying for and what will need a separate agreement.

Consultation first. A plan when you need one.

Free consultation — $0

Tell me what you want to achieve. We establish fit and whether it makes sense to continue. This conversation does not include free specification work or free design.

Discovery (scoped, paid) — $600

Discovery gathers your goals, constraints, and specifications and presents the route forward. It produces a plan; it is not another name for a consultation call. The discovery fee is credited toward build on acceptance.

Implementation and design are separate specifications for a build. Client-facing specifications are delivered as styled PDFs, with the design covering the theme package and page contracts where relevant.

Request a free consultation → /#consultation

Tell me what you are trying to do, whether you already have a site or system, and which service interests you. We will start by checking fit — not by assuming a purchase.

title: Small Business Website Build | Keith Soyka
description: A Standard 4-page site for $2,900, with documented page contracts, tested delivery, and a clear handoff. Start with a free fit consultation.
summary: A from-scratch website that tells people what you sell, explains how you can help, and gives them a clear way to contact you. The plan, design, and handoff are part of the work—not details you have to reconstruct later.
bodyHtml:
$2,900

A from-scratch website that tells people what you sell, explains how you can help, and gives them a clear way to contact you. The plan, design, and handoff are part of the work—not details you have to reconstruct later.

Primary action: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

What you walk away with

Four defined pages: landing, contact, about, and terms/privacy. You receive the site and the documentation needed to understand its structure, run it, and hand it to another maintainer.

What's included

  • The standard four-page build: landing, contact, about, terms/privacy.
  • Separate implementation and design specifications. The design includes a theme package: global tokens, color scheme, and branding breakdown. Client-facing specifications arrive as styled PDFs.
  • Page contracts explaining each page's purpose, connections, flow, and intended behavior.
  • Documented build, test, and deployment scripts and a Dockerized build for portability.
  • README, quickstart, CurrentState, manifest, index, handoff guide, and troubleshooting document.
  • Workflows and skills tailored to the agreed stack; API flow documentation if APIs are involved.
  • File-level provenance and a test suite run green before handoff.

What's not included

Digital Intelligence (DI) integration is not part of this offer. Logo / branding and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped add-ons. The four-page price is not an unlimited-page or unlimited-feature package; changes beyond the agreed scope need a separate agreement.

Hosting is a choice to be compared, not a single bundled platform promise. Hosting arrangements and costs are confirmed in scope. The terms/privacy page is part of the four-page structure; the content responsibilities for it must be agreed before the build.

Start with fit, then a defined plan

Free consultation — $0: explain what you need; we check fit. No free specification work or free design is included in that call.

Discovery (scoped, paid) — $600: gather goals, constraints, and specifications and present the route forward. Credited toward build on acceptance. The implementation and design specifications then keep the build anchored to an agreed plan.

Action label: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

Relevant work and delivery examples

  • PROOF PLACEHOLDER W1 — four-page or comparable website portfolio piece; approved URL required Show page structure and the delivered interface. Do not imply a client engagement without verified attribution.
  • PROOF PLACEHOLDER W2 — page-contract and handoff-kit sample; approved URL required Show what the buyer receives beyond the visible pages.

Back to all services

Questions before you decide

Does this include Digital Intelligence (DI)?

No. This offer is the Standard 4-page site without DI integration.

Can another developer maintain it?

The repository, Dockerized build, scripts, and documentation are designed for handoff. Ongoing maintenance by me is separately scoped, not a condition of taking the work elsewhere.
reviewNotes: Approved proof samples are not supplied; hosting, changes/revisions, schedule, payment split, and terms/privacy content and responsibility remain unsettled.
The timing and conditions for pre-sale design materials need confirmation; the consultation remains fit-only.

title: DI Opportunity Audit for Your Business | Keith Soyka
description: A $950 DI opportunity audit to assess where Digital Intelligence (DI) could benefit your business—and where it does not fit. Implementation is separate.
summary: Where could Digital Intelligence (DI) help your current business—and where would it be the wrong tool? Start with that question before committing to an integration.
bodyHtml:
$950

Where could Digital Intelligence (DI) help your current business—and where would it be the wrong tool? Start with that question before committing to an integration.

Primary action: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

What you walk away with

A standalone assessment of where Digital Intelligence (DI) could be beneficial in your current business. The point is to establish useful fit, not to justify a build that you do not need. If it cannot help, I will say so.

What's included

  • An audit focused on opportunities within your current business.
  • Consideration of whether Digital Intelligence (DI) is beneficial—not just whether it can be added.
  • Clear boundaries agreed before the engagement, including what will be reviewed and how the findings will be delivered.

What's not included

This is an audit, not implementation of a website, software tool, or integration. It does not commit you to a later build. A build's repository, deployment scripts, and software test suite are not audit deliverables.

The review scope and delivery format are agreed before purchase. No guaranteed savings, revenue increase, or technical outcome is part of the offer.

Consultation is not discovery

Free consultation — $0: explain the business question and establish fit. It does not include free specification work or free design.

Discovery (scoped, paid) — $600: when a separate planning engagement is needed, it gathers goals, constraints, and specifications and presents a route forward. The fee is credited toward build on acceptance—not automatically toward an audit.

We will make clear which engagement you need before proceeding.

Action label: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

Relevant work and delivery examples

  • PROOF PLACEHOLDER A1 — approved opportunity-assessment sample; URL required Demonstrate how an assessment distinguishes a useful opportunity from a poor fit. Do not fabricate a completed audit.
  • PROOF PLACEHOLDER A2 — relevant portfolio case or documented decision example; approved URL required Show the reasoning behind a Digital Intelligence (DI) use case without claiming unverified client results.

Back to all services

Questions before you decide

Will the audit always recommend an integration?

No. I do not sell Digital Intelligence (DI) where it does not fit. A useful assessment can conclude that adding it is not the right move.

Is a build included in the audit price?

No. The audit is a standalone offer. Any implementation needs its own scope and agreement.

A two-week engagement focused on an agreed operations scope. Start by defining the work and what completion means—not by assuming every operational problem can fit into a sprint.

Primary action: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

What you walk away with

The work and deliverables agreed for the two-week sprint. Before you commit, we define the operational problem, the boundaries of the engagement, and the criteria for accepting the result.

What's included

  • A two-week sprint.
  • A scope agreed before the engagement, with the deliverables and acceptance criteria stated explicitly.
  • For any software build included in that agreed scope: documented scripts, a Dockerized build for portability, and README, quickstart, CurrentState, manifest, index, handoff, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • For that build work: stack-specific workflows and skills, file-level provenance, tests run green before handoff, page contracts where pages are involved, and API and Digital Intelligence (DI) flow documentation where applicable. A Digital Intelligence (DI) integration includes its maintenance collaborator alongside the system component.

What's not included

The two-week window is not an open-ended operations engagement. Unspecified implementation, integrations, follow-on changes, and ongoing maintenance are not promised by the offer name or price. Any work outside the agreed scope needs a separate agreement.

Digital Intelligence (DI) is not added simply to fill a package. It has to fit the problem.

Establish fit before defining the sprint

Free consultation — $0: explain the operations problem; we establish fit. The call does not include free specification work or free design.

Discovery (scoped, paid) — $600: a separate planning engagement gathers goals, constraints, and specifications and presents the route forward. Credited toward build on acceptance. Whether discovery is needed for your sprint is made clear before you proceed.

Does two weeks mean every operations problem will be solved?

No. The sprint is bounded by the work agreed in scope. The duration does not promise unlimited delivery.

No ongoing maintenance is promised here. If maintenance is needed, it is separately scoped.

Bring Digital Intelligence (DI) into a defined part of your small business—not into every process by default. The integration needs to fit the work, and you need to understand how to run and maintain it after handoff.

Primary action: Request a free consultation → /#consultation

The integration defined in your agreed scope, with its API and Digital Intelligence (DI) flows documented. The system's DI component is paired with a maintenance collaborator so the delivery includes both the working piece and support for understanding its upkeep.
